title: Run a standard-expression operation
summary: Interpret, validate, normalize, query, convert, or explicitly detect one supported standard expression without guessing its language or dialect.

operations.title: Run standard-expression semantics
operations.description: Apply one explicit operation to Cron, npm SemVer range, CIDR, RFC 3986 URI, HTTP Content-Type, ISO 8601 duration, RFC 5545 RRULE, or Unix permission syntax. Detection returns candidates instead of silently selecting a kind, and time-relative work requires explicit context.

errors.description: The Capability adapter request envelope or operation selection is invalid.
The provider could not return a structured semantic result.
